 Tip
When investigating devices in the Security Copilot portal, Microsoft recommends
including the word Defender in your prompts to ensure that the device summary
capability delivers the results.
Your feedback helps improve the quality of the results generated by Copilot. You can provide
feedback about the results by navigating to the bottom of the Copilot pane and selecting the
feedback icon
.
